system.description:
Battle Trance

Battle Amp

Furious Advantage. You have advantage on Checks and saving throws using your Taijutsu Ability score.

Furious Resilience. You have resistance to one damage type of your choice, which you pick when you enter Battle Trance. This increases to two choices at 10th and three choices at 17th.

Furious Focus. You cannot maintain concentration on non Taijutsu or Bukijutsu based effects for the duration of your Battle Trance.

Level 6

Frenzied Assault. When you deal damage with an attack or Bukijutsu that uses Polearm or Flail weapons, you add +2 damage. This increases to +4 at 14th level. At the start of your turn, you can forgo this damage bonus to gain advantage on the first attack you make that uses a Polearm or Flail weapon.

Frenzy Roar. When you take damage from a creature within 15 feet of you, you can spend your reaction and 2 Discipline to release a roar that shakes the battlefield. The triggering creature and all other hostile creatures within 15 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw gaining 2 ranks of Demoralized or Shaken on a failed save, or 1 rank on a successful save.

Undying Frenzy. When you would fall to 0 hit points, you can spend 3 Discipline to instead fall to 1 hit point. When you do, you end your Battle Trance state. You cannot use this ability again for 10 minutes.

The Weapon Specialists who follow the Fang Breaker Doctrine devote themselves savagery through the mastery of polearms and flails, striking in wide arcs, binding, ensnaring, or crashing through the strongest defense. Unlike styles built on precision alone, Fang Breakers overwhelm foes with relentless control, forcing openings and dismantling defenses piece by piece.
